facts.material: polyester and epoxy resin based pigmented formulation
facts.function: decorative or protective coating applied to surfaces and heat-cured
facts.form: dry powder, no solvent or aqueous medium

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3210 'other paints and varnishes'; heading 3208 and 3209 require dispersion or solution in a nonaqueous or aqueous medium, which a dry powder lacks
Chapter 32 notes do not exclude; Chapter 39 not applicable to finished coating preparations

rejected_alternatives.reason: requires paints dispersed or dissolved in a nonaqueous medium; powder coating has no medium
primary-form polyesters or epoxides; this is a formulated pigmented coating preparation

missing_facts: whether the powder is pigmented or a clear coat
classification.rationale: A dry polyester/epoxy powder coating is a paint-type product not dispersed in any medium, so it falls in the residual paint heading 3210 (single 10-digit line). No in-force ruling on the same good was found in cross_search, so none is cited.
